$comment: Lighthouse CI config for .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml, which runs on each Netlify deploy preview. The URLs are not listed here: the workflow builds them from its hand-maintained LIGHTHOUSE_PATHS and the preview's base URL. Thresholds sit just below the medians of the first real run (PR #155, September 2026); raise them as scores improve, and never lower one to pass a run without a reason recorded here. /bank-reconciliation/ has its own best-practices threshold because the bookings embed logs cookie warnings in Chrome's Issues panel (inspector-issues), which this site cannot fix. third-party-cookies is skipped for the same reason: the only third-party cookie is Stripe's, set inside the bookings iframe. is-crawlable is skipped because Netlify serves every deploy preview with x-robots-tag: noindex (indexability is enforced by the SEO check over dist/). chat.withotto.app is blocked so Chatwoot never creates contacts in the live sales inbox.
